comments.content: Kicking off this issue slowly. I will work on base architecture and examples. Anyone can get assigned and continue working on top of the progress I've made.

Here's a quick instruction if you wanna take over the issue on top of the latest progress I've made:
1/ Fork the `feat/unit-test` branch to your local repo cause I am continuously pushing new stuff.
2/ Add *.spec.ts in `test` folder like [address.spec.ts](https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquibot/blob/feat/unit-test/test/utils/address.spec.ts).
3/ You can add specific files to [exclude list](https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquibot/blob/feat/unit-test/.nycrc.json#L3) for the coverage. In the ideal case, we shouldn't add anything to the exclude list. we can add index/schema/types files to the exclude list.
4/ Feel free to ask to @0xcodercrane or any admins if you have any questions/comments/improvements.
